The attached issue's existing agent PR failed CI. Inspect the worktree and failure context included in the task, repair only the regression, and run relevant local checks. Do not call GitHub, commit, push, or open/merge a PR. The controller validates and publishes the repair.

If the failing CI check passes locally, do not stop at "cannot reproduce": a red CI against a green local run means the failure depends on the runner environment. CI runners are Linux, UTC, on a fresh install. Examine the failing assertion or step for environment-sensitive input — local-timezone datetime rendering, locale-formatted numbers, filesystem case sensitivity, Node version differences — and make the failing check environment-independent (e.g. assert through the same formatter/helper the implementation uses), then prove it by re-running under the CI-like setting (e.g. `TZ=UTC`).
